newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bank to loan 361 mln yuan to firms.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bank to loan 361 mln yuan to firms.

text.p: The Shanghai branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China has decided to lend 361 million yuan to city state-owned firms that produce famous brands, the Xinmin Evening News said on Monday.
The newspaper said the loans would be used by firms in the light industrial sector to enable them to enlarge production capacity of 20 well-known products.

Among the companies receiving the loans will be eight listed on Shanghai's stock market, including Shanghai Shangling Electric Appliances, Shanghai Hero, Shanghai Forever Bicycle and China First Pencil, the paper said.
There are 58 well-known Shanghai light industrial products with a total annual turnover of 21 billion yuan, it added but gave no more details.
